items.summary: Preprint on multimodal language models that skip a separate vision encoder and appear to learn encoder-like behavior internally.
items.whyItMatters: Relevant if you weigh the cost of vision-encoder stacks in multimodal models.

items.summary: Preprint introducing a harness for testing visual agents that use tools, with a multimodal memory component.
items.whyItMatters: Another testbed for evaluating tool-using vision agents.

items.summary: Preprint on generating physics problems by instantiating formulas top-down and checking them by executing code.
items.whyItMatters: Niche, but shows code execution as a check for synthetic data.

items.summary: Preprint on a sampling method that keeps diverse candidates alive during decoding of diffusion language models.
items.whyItMatters: Useful if you follow diffusion LLM decoding.

items.summary: Preprint examining whether confidence signals inside large language models measure what they claim to.
items.whyItMatters: Caution before trusting model-internal confidence scores.

items.summary: Extended version of a paper on adapting object detectors to bad-weather imagery without source data.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow computer-vision niche.

items.summary: Position paper arguing evolutionary search methods built on LLMs should be compared at equal token budgets.
items.whyItMatters: Gives a fairer baseline for comparing LLM search methods.

items.summary: Second version of a system that evolves agent skills automatically, starting from benchmark adaptation.
items.whyItMatters: Early look at automated skill improvement for agents.

items.summary: Preprint that finds and steers experts tied to fast versus slow thinking in multimodal mixture-of-experts models.
items.whyItMatters: Hints at cheaper reasoning control in MoE models.

items.summary: Preprint on routing among several experts for weakly supervised referring expression comprehension.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow vision-language subfield.

items.summary: Theory paper on when vision-language models can reliably list every item in an image.
items.whyItMatters: Frames a known weakness: incomplete object listing.

items.summary: AWS case study on Deepgram running its voice AI workloads on Trainium chips.
items.whyItMatters: Customer data point for non-Nvidia inference hardware.

items.summary: Hugging Face post on TorchNeuron, a path to run Hugging Face models on AWS Trainium with native PyTorch.
items.whyItMatters: Lowers the effort to try Trainium with existing HF code.

items.summary: PyTorch Blog announcement of TorchNeuron, a native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium.
items.whyItMatters: Native PyTorch support removes a major barrier to Trainium.

items.summary: Preprint on tracking the lifecycle of a skill library while training agents with reinforcement learning.
items.whyItMatters: Skill libraries need maintenance; this proposes how.

items.summary: Preprint linking vision-language model failures to persistent mismatches between visual and text representations.
items.whyItMatters: Diagnostic framing for VLM failure analysis.

items.summary: Preprint on building compact reusable memory from long videos to answer many later queries.
items.whyItMatters: Helps with cost of repeated long-video queries.

items.summary: Preprint applying evolution strategies to continual learning at test time.
items.whyItMatters: Gradient-free adaptation idea worth tracking.

items.summary: Preprint on generating CAD mechanisms that actually function, not just look right.
items.whyItMatters: Niche engineering application.

items.summary: Preprint using cipher-based training to improve in-context learning of terms for rare-language translation.
items.whyItMatters: Niche low-resource translation approach.

items.summary: Preprint proposing instance-level early stopping guided by second-order loss dynamics.
items.whyItMatters: Theory-heavy; limited near-term use.

items.summary: Preprint probing whether language models represent the roles variables play in code.
items.whyItMatters: Interpretability groundwork for code models.

items.summary: Preprint on conformal thresholds for classes that have no calibration data.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow uncertainty-estimation niche.

items.summary: Preprint showing marginal coverage can hide failures for specific routes in adaptive VLM ensembles.
items.whyItMatters: Cautions on aggregate coverage metrics.

items.summary: Preprint on structured latent dynamics for long-horizon embodied world models.
items.whyItMatters: Incremental world-model work.

items.summary: Preprint questioning weakly supervised localization results on chest radiographs and proposing PACE.
items.whyItMatters: Medical imaging niche; flags evaluation pitfalls.

items.summary: Benchmark testing spatial understanding with views that contradict each other.
items.whyItMatters: New probe for spatial reasoning in multimodal models.

items.summary: Preprint on one model that creates audio and video together, using progressive training.
items.whyItMatters: Joint audio-video generation is a growing area.

items.summary: Preprint on few-shot segmentation that pairs visual memory with text alignment.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow vision subfield.

items.summary: Preprint on generating longitudinal radiology reports with temporal decoupling.
items.whyItMatters: Medical niche.
